compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem
`src/rebar/_signing_hmac.py` (276 LOC) keeps HMAC key custody, `compute_signature` and `verify_record` alive, but nothing mints HMAC: all 3,883 live SIGNATURE events are op-certs; `sign_manifest` mints only via `mint_opcert_record` (`src/rebar/signing.py:218`). HMAC op-cert-kind records already read NOT-certified (`_hmac_opcert_not_certified`, `_signing_hmac.py:259-276`). Yet the verify path still reads `REBAR_SIGNING_KEY` / `<tracker>/.signing-key` (`signing.py:157,268,278`; `src/rebar/_engine_support/validate.py:87-92`), and `rebar init` still mints an unused secret (`_gen_local_files`, `src/rebar/_commands/init.py:455-467`). 688 folded SNAPSHOTs carry HMAC entries (1 on an open ticket); the reducer folds them verbatim (`src/rebar/reducer/_processors.py:503-510`) without `_signing_hmac`, so they keep rendering and must verify `unsigned`. Operator ruling 2026-09-06: retire HMAC entirely. Basis: origin/main b97d414b8e2.

## Approach
1. `src/rebar/signing.py`: replace the `_signing_hmac` import with
```python
LEGACY_HMAC_ALGORITHM = "HMAC-SHA256"  # recognised on read only; never minted
HMAC_RETIRED_ON = "2026-09"

def retired_scheme_verdict(record: dict | None) -> dict:
    record = record if isinstance(record, dict) else {}
    raw = record.get("manifest"); manifest = raw if isinstance(raw, list) else []
    key_id = record.get("key_id")
    legacy = bool(record.get("signature")) or record.get("algorithm") == LEGACY_HMAC_ALGORITHM
    return {"manifest": manifest, "step_count": len(manifest),
            "algorithm": record.get("algorithm"),
            "key_id": key_id if isinstance(key_id, str) else None,
            "signed_at": record.get("signed_at"), "head_sha": record.get("head_sha"),
            "verified_at_sha": verified_at_sha_from_manifest(manifest) or record.get("verified_at_sha"),
            "rebar_version": rebar_version_from_manifest(manifest),
            "verified": False, "verdict": "unsigned",
            "reason": (f"legacy HMAC scheme retired ({HMAC_RETIRED_ON}); re-run the gate to mint an op-cert"
                       if legacy else "ticket has no signature")}
```
2. `verify_attestation_record(record, ticket_id, *, kind=None, repo_root=None)`: drop the `key` kwarg and the `attestation_kind` import; envelope -> `verify_opcert_record(...)`, else `retired_scheme_verdict(record)`. `OPCERT_KINDS` stays (imported by `_commands/remote_cert.py`, `opcert_service/jobs.py`); reword its comment (`signing.py:111-114`) to drop `compute_signature`/`verify_record`.
3. `_resolve_and_reduce` returns `(resolved, state)`; `verify_signature`/`verify_attestations` stop passing `key=`. Delete the unreachable legacy render branch in `sign_cli` (`signing.py:384-390`). Rewrite the module docstring and `__all__`: remove `ALGORITHM`, `PAYLOAD_VERSION`, `_NO_KEY`, `_canonical_payload`, `_generate_key_file`, `_hmac_opcert_not_certified`, `compute_signature`, `key_fingerprint`, `signing_key`, `verify_record`; add the three new names. `_commands/completion_bundle.py:288` and `llm/completion_child_gate.py:164` pass no `key=`; unchanged.
4. `signature_findings` (`validate.py:70-142`): delete the `signing_key` read and `_NO_KEY` short-circuit (`:87-92`) and `key=key` (`:123-124`). The scan now always runs: `mismatch`/`invalid`/`key_not_valid_at_era` -> major, `foreign_key` -> minor, `unsigned`/`certified` silent, so HMAC-only records emit nothing. Rewrite the docstring (`:71-81`) to drop the key-less no-op claim.
5. `init.py`: delete the `.signing-key` mint (`:460-466`) and `import uuid` (`:21`, sole use); reword the comment. Keep `.signing-key` in `_init_ensures.py` `_GITIGNORE` (existing stores carry the file; `.closure-key` precedent).
6. Kept read-compat: `reducer/_present.py::_strip_hex`, nullable `signature`/`key_id` in `schemas/sign_result.schema.json` (reword "RETIRED (2026-09): never emitted; pre-retirement records only"), `ticket_state.signature`. The `verify_signature_result.schema.json` enum and `types.py` Literal are unchanged (`foreign_key`/`unknown_scheme` stay live op-cert verdicts); prose only.
7. Prose sweep (comments only): `_signing_manifest.py:69-71,93`, `attest/__init__.py:7-12`, `attest/registry.py:22-24,37`, `attest/opcert.py:29-33,342`, `_opcert_signing.py:4,32,496,521`, `_mcp_reads.py` `verify_signature` tool docstring, `_store/env_identity.py`, `_lib_identity.py`, `llm/plan_review/attest_gate.py:122,196`, `reducer/llm_format.py:111,126`.
8. Docs: `manifest-signing.md` legacy section, `reuse-surface.md` (delete HMAC primitives; `:3,89,125,134`), `attest-substrate.md` scope note, `plan-review-gate.md:593`, `repo-snapshot-gates.md:154` (`unknown_scheme` -> `unsigned`, keep "HMAC-SHA256" for `tests/unit/test_snapshot_docs.py`), `event-schema.md:51`, `exit-codes.md:202`, `config.md:814` (drop `REBAR_SIGNING_KEY`), `migrations/hmac-opcert-removal.md` (append "## Retirement (2026-09)"), `env-vars.md` regenerated by `scripts/gen_env_registry.py`, `release-notes.md` BREAKING entry (text in the release-note comment).
9. Baselines: `scripts/gen_api_surface.py --update`; `scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --update-stale` (drops `env_var::REBAR_SIGNING_KEY`); complexity ratchet only shrinks.
10. ADR amendments: 0044 Context and 0049 section 10 ("Contract completed (2026-09)").

Tests: delete HMAC tests in `tests/unit/test_signing.py`, `test_canonical_consolidation.py` (sign goldens), `test_signing_module_split.py` (hmac seam), `test_api_surface_gate.py` (HMAC param pins), `test_hmac_opcert_removal_8f1d.py::test_generic_hmac_utility_still_works_for_non_opcert`, `lifecycle/test_signature.py` (env-key and readonly-key tests), `lifecycle/test_attested_signing.py::test_payload_version_unchanged`, `test_rebar_repo_isolation.py::test_signing_key_keeps_restrictive_mode`, `tests/scripts/test_residual_drain_seam_clean_heldout.py` env test. Rewrite HMAC fixtures (8f1d, `test_opcert_producer_seam_8d8e.py`, `test_opcert_storage_heldout.py`) as literal dicts asserting `unsigned`; `test_signature.py` convergence test onto op-cert events; `test_attested_signing.py::test_pin_enters_signed_bytes` onto envelopes; drop `.signing-key` from `_IDENTITY_FILES` (`tests/_topology_template.py`, `tests/interfaces/_store_template.py`) and `_signing_hmac.py` from `test_stamped_lock.py` survivors; delete every `REBAR_SIGNING_KEY` setenv in tests.

## Scope
In: the files named above. Out: `infra/**` (`MCP_HMAC_SIGNING_KEY`), SSO/JWT HMAC in `_mcp_auth.py`, `identity.signing_key` (SSH authorship), `docs/security.md`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `src/rebar/_signing_hmac.py` is absent and `tests/unit/test_hmac_retirement.py::test_no_hmac_readers_remain` passes: a Python scan of `src/**/*.py` finds no match of `\bsigning_key\(|REBAR_SIGNING_KEY|compute_signature|\bverify_record\b|_signing_hmac|_canonical_payload|key_fingerprint|_hmac_opcert_not_certified|_generate_key_file` (`_resolve_signing_key` in `_mcp_auth.py` does not match `\bsigning_key\(`).
- [ ] A ticket whose SNAPSHOT carries a live-shaped HMAC `plan-review` attestation reduces, and `rebar show` renders it without `signature` hex (test a).
- [ ] `rebar verify-signature <id> --kind plan-review --output json` on it exits 1 with `verdict == "unsigned"` and reason containing "legacy HMAC scheme retired" (test b); MCP `plan_review_status` reports not certified (test c).
- [ ] `signature_findings` emits nothing for a store of HMAC-only records (test d).
- [ ] `rebar init` creates no `.signing-key` (test e), and setting `REBAR_SIGNING_KEY` changes no verdict.
- [ ] `docs/env-vars.md` has no `REBAR_SIGNING_KEY` row and `scripts/gen_env_registry.py --check`, `scripts/gen_api_surface.py --check`, `scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check` pass.
- [ ] ADR 0044/0049 amended; migration doc has "## Retirement (2026-09)"; release note present.
- [ ] `make verify` exits 0.

## Rollback
Single commit; reverting restores HMAC verify losslessly (no record is mutated).
